\title "Loop edge 11: grace notes"
\tempo 120
.
// Before-beat grace at the very start of the score: negative playback tick.
:4 0.1{gr} 3.1 5.1 7.1 8.1 |
// Before-beat grace at a bar start takes time from the previous bar.
:4 2.1{gr} 3.1 5.1 7.1 8.1 |
// On-beat grace in the middle of a bar.
:4 3.1 5.1{gr ob} 7.1 8.1 10.1 |
// Grace chord at the start of a repeat.
\ro :4 (0.1 2.2){gr} (3.1 5.2) 5.1 7.1 8.1 |
\rc 2 :4 3.1 5.1 7.1{gr} 8.1 10.1 |
:1 0.1
